ingest.note: Audio sent back to the PSTN caller must be G.711 μ-law 8 kHz.

egress.note: Inbound caller audio arrives as G.711 μ-law 8 kHz mono over the Voice API media stream WebSocket.

potholes.note: Telephony audio is narrowband μ-law 8 kHz. A decode and resample stage is mandatory before any model.
The media stream connects via an NCCO WebSocket endpoint; ensure the answer URL returns the correct NCCO before streaming.
